summary: The 'gaia' project is a well-structured multi-agent system implemented using the SPADE framework. it addresses all requirements from requirements.json, including real-time availability checking, reservations, cancellations, and modifications through specialized agent behaviors.

findings.description: Uses SPADE framework which provides robust multi-agent communication and lifecycle management.
findings.evidence: from spade.agent import Agent in agents/user_agent.py

findings.description: Explicit behaviors for each requirement: CheckAvailabilityBehaviour, InitiateReservationBehaviour, CancelReservationBehaviour, etc.
findings.evidence: user_agent.py defines behaviours for all core tasks.

findings.description: Uses Pydantic for data validation and custom logger for traceability.
findings.evidence: from pydantic import BaseModel in models/parking_lot.py

implementation_risks: The system relies on a local XMPP server (localhost) for SPADE agents, which must be running for the system to work.
